19 ([[Nightmare Carnival]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]50,000 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Fast (4.5) |spawned_by = [[Jack O' Bot]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Burn}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Axe Swing}}''' - The '''Jaxe''' swings its axe in one direction hitting towers and stunning them. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Jaxe''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that first appeared in [[Nightmare Carnival]] as part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. It was very dangerous then due to its high health and average walk speed. It could also be spawned by [[Jack O' Bot]]. The '''Jaxe''' also appeared in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|legacy Hidden Wave]], and therefore [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. Again, it had very high health, moved at an average speed and could stun towers by swinging its axe. ==Appearance== The '''Jaxe''' had a pumpkin head and green skin. Its torso was black and its legs were cobblestone black. It wore a black cape and a metal wristband on its left arm. It had cobblestone and metal-plated armor, complete with an orange gem in the middle of its chestplate. It wielded a grey skull axe to attack the towers. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] and [[Ranger]] are recommended against the '''Jaxe'''. **The [[Commander]] is highly recommended in order to boost the firerate of towers. *The [[Freezer]], [[Sledger]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Electroshocker]] can also be very useful in slowing the '''Jaxe''' down. **Be aware that, due to the '''Jaxe's''' large size, they can only be slowed down for a shorter period of time compared to an average-sized [[Enemies|enemy]]. **You can also use [[Toxic Gunner]] to slow down this enemy by 50%. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} Hallewoewq.PNG|'''Jaxe''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} IconI.png|'''Jaxe''' on the game icon. EHNzIeVWwAYozcj.jpg|'''Jaxe''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} EHNzIecXkAAdi79.jpg|'''Jaxe''' on a promotional image. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Jaxe''' is loosely based on [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Jack|Jack]] from ''Tower Battles''. *The head of the '''Jaxe''' is the {{RLinkC|17450053|Sinister P.}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. **The axe of the '''Jaxe''' is the {{RLinkC|64372659|Fiery Dragon Axe - a Target exclusive item!}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Jaxe's''' name is a portmanteau of the words "Jack" in "Jack-o" and "axe" ==Update History== *'''18 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.1|Release v1.1.0]] **'''Jaxe''' added. *'''9 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.2|Release v1.2.0]] **'''Jaxe''' removed. *'''25 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.3|Release v1.3.0]] **'''Jaxe''' added to [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]]. *'''29 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.4|Release v1.4.0]] **Health increased from 20,000 to 50,000. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Jaxe''' cannot stun towers. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Jaxe''' removed. {{HiddenWave|[[Frost Hero (Frost Invasion)|Frost Hero]]|Jaxe|[[Mechanical Rot (Legacy)|Mechanical Rot]]}} {{NightmareCarnival|[[Swamp Thing]]|Wave 18|Jaxe|Wave 19|[[Jack O' Bot]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Jaxe}}
